items.headline:
China’s exports to the US are rebounding sharply:

Chinese exports to the US surged +34% YoY in August to $42.5 billion, surpassing $40.0 billion for the 3rd consecutive month.

This marks the 5th consecutive month of growth and the 2nd-largest YoY increase in at least 5 years.
